response:
关闭「包含明细」后，明细字段会隐藏，但仍保留原来的「保留内容」，也不会参与必填校验；公司名称始终必填。点击按钮只生成一份可编辑的检查草稿。

```kelivo-ui
ui 1 catalog "kelivo.native/1"
root = Column(children=[form,ask], gap="large")
form = Form(children=[toggle,nameField,detailField], title="公司发票信息")
$on: boolean = false
$name: string = ""
$detail: string = "保留内容"
toggle = Switch(label="包含明细", bind=$on)
nameField = TextField(label="公司名称", bind=$name, required=true, maxLength=200)
detailField = TextField(label="发票明细", bind=$detail, required=true, visible=$on, multiline=true, maxLength=2000)
ask = Button(label="准备检查草稿", form=form, action=Ask(text="请检查这份公司发票表单的内容，并指出需要修正或补充的地方。", context={"name":$name,"enabled":$on,"detail":$detail}))
```
